{{Quote|Be careful when purchasing an NR-5. A small company called "Tredwall" is marketing an NR knockoff that works for about ten hours before completely frying all of its circuits!|Kraemr, on Cynabar's Droid Datalog|<ref name="Cynabar's Fantastic Technology" />}}
'''"Tredwall"''' was a small [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturer<ref name="Cynabar's Fantastic Technology" /> comprised of [[Outlaw tech/Legends|outlaw techs]] in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]].<ref name="CSWE" /> It stole the designs for several [[Kalibac Industries]] (KI) droids and produced cheap, faulty imitations,<ref name="Cynabar's Fantastic Technology" /> further diminishing KI's reputation after its operations were severely weakened by a series of lawsuits brought on by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]]<ref name="CSWE" /> over shared components.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Droids">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]],<ref name="2 BBY">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the zero point in the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]], to 35:3 under the [[Great ReSynchronization]] dating system. ''The Essential Atlas'' also places the [[Battle of Selaggis]] on 43:2:28 and the [[Battle of Dathomir (Hunt for Zsinj)|Battle of Dathomir]] on 43:3:21. ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' and ''The Essential Atlas'' both place the Battle of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. ''The Essential Guide to Warfare'' also places the Battle of [[Selaggis system/Legends|Selaggis]] in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], confirming the placement of the division between each Galactic Standard Calendar [[Standard year/Legends|year]] as the third [[Standard month/Legends|month]] in the Great ReSynchronization year. Thus, there is a two-month gap between the two dating systems, and the first two months of a GrS year are the last two of the preceding Galactic Standard Calendar year. According to {{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|life/13228_2.html|RM&S; Debates Calendar Reform}}, the Great ReSynchronization was instituted 13 years prior to the article's publication on 13:2:28. Using this information and the Battle of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin's]] GRS date allow us to determine that the Great ReSynchronization was instituted in [[35 BBY/Legends|35 BBY]] and date the afformentioned article to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Thus, there is a total difference of 35 years and 2 months between the two systems.<br />Based on the provided information, 33:4:3:08 occurred in the year [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. According to ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', the [[NR-5 Series Repair Droid]] was produced by [[Kalibac Industries]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], whose beginning is dated to 2 BBY by ''The Essential Atlas''. In addition, according to ''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]'', Tredwall marketed NR knockoffs in 33:4:3:08 (2 BBY), when genuine NR-5s were available for purchase. As a result, it can be assumed that the NR knockoff was introduced in 2 BBY.</ref> Tredwall produced and marketed a [[NR knockoff|knockoff]] of KI's [[NR-5 Series Repair Droid]] that worked almost ten [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] before completely frying all its circuits. A [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] known as "[[Faddo]]" worked for the company as a wandering sales representative, selling defective droids to gullible marks on the [[Vohai Unirail]] while avoiding persecution by the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law]]. An individual known as [[Kraemr]] warned potential NR-5 buyers of the NR knockoff on [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]. Having been swindled by Faddo, an individual identified as [[Drev (Cynabar's Droid Datalog)|Drev]], via the Datalog, invited those scammed by the Tredwall [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] to meet him on<ref name="Cynabar's Fantastic Technology" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Suns of Fortune">''[[Suns of Fortune]]''</ref> [[Selonia/Legends|Selonia]] in the next [[Standard month/Legends|month]] to help Drev exact vengeance.<ref name="Cynabar's Fantastic Technology" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tredwall was mentioned in ''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]'', a [[1997]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] supplement written by [[Drew Campbell]] and [[Eric S. Trautmann]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Cynabar's Fantastic Technology" />
